python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include')
needles=['zone_status_change','status_change_notif','custom_cluster_cmd','cluster_cmd_req','raw_cmd','general_cmd','ias_cie','zone_enroll']
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if not p.is_file():
        continue
    text=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    low=text.lower()
    hits=[n for n in needles if n in low]
    if not hits:
        continue
    lines=text.splitlines()
    print('===',p,'hits',hits,'===')
    for i,line in enumerate(lines):
        if any(n in line.lower() for n in needles):
            a=max(0,i-8)
            b=min(len(lines),i+18)
            for j in range(a,b):
                print(f'{j+1:4d}: {lines[j]}')
            print()
PY
